newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Q4 ordinary time wages rise 1.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Q4 ordinary time wages rise 1.2 pct.

text.p: Australian average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) for adults employed full time rose 1.2 percent in the three months to November, seasonally adjusted, the Bureau of Statistics said.
On an annual basis, earnings rose 3.9 percent.
Average weekly ordinary adult earnings (percentage change):
Economists had on average forecast a 0.9 percent rise on the quarter for an annual 3.6 percent.
Seasonally adjusted AWOTE rose 1.0 percent in the three months to August 1996 for an annual rise of 3.8 percent.
The Bureau said full-time adult total earnings rose 1.3 percent on the quarter for an annual rise of 3.8 percent, against 3.7 percent in the previous quarter.
Total earnings for all employees rose 0.4 percent, taking annual growth to 2.9 percent, from 3.4 percent.
